We got two templates. Need to find which matches our target molecule. The first template (reaction_id 214705) seems to be a generic sulfonamide formation from sulfonyl chloride and aniline? Let's examine retro_smarts_template: '[O;D1;H0:2]=[S;H0;D4;+0:1](=[O;D1;H0:3])(-[c:4])-[NH;D2;+0:5]-[c:6]>>O-[S;H0;D4;+0:1](=[O;D1;H0:2])(=[O;D1;H0:3])-[c:4].[NH2;D1;+0:5]-[c:6]'

So it breaks N-S bond, forms sulfonyl chloride (O-S(=O)(=O)-c) and aniline (NH2-c). That matches our retrosynthesis: target sulfonamide -> sulfonyl chloride + aniline.
